description: An open-ended observation and discussion routine in which learners first state what they notice about an artifact, image, or problem, then pose questions about what they wonder — surfacing prior knowledge and curiosity before instruction.
title: I Notice I Wonder

description: A reflection routine in which learners articulate their prior belief about a topic and then state how their thinking has changed, making conceptual change visible.
title: I Used To Think Now I Think

description: A gradual release of responsibility sequence in which the instructor models a task, learners attempt it with support, and then perform it independently.
title: I Do, We Do, You Do

description: Students regularly record open-ended "I wonder" questions about their experiences and observations, which teachers use to fuel inquiry and plan instruction.
title: I Wonder Journals
